gitCommit.subject: Public site: TSX-MR as a development brand; one quick-link group; pages open at the top
gitCommit.body:
Public site: TSX-MR as a development brand; one quick-link group; pages open at the top

Positioning (the owner's brief of 2026-10-17, fourth):
- The home page introduces TSX-MR — an independent development brand managed
  by a Mauritanian developer — with "Discuss your project", three service
  cards, Dukan ERP as its featured own product, a four-step process and a
  closing invitation (content/brand.ts). New Services page (/services, /fr,
  /ar). The Dukan ERP detail moves from the home page to the product page
  (content/home.ts -> content/dukan-overview.ts). Nav: Services, Products,
  About, Support, Contact. About, Products, Contact and metadata follow.
  No team, client, figure, award or guarantee; no client work shown.

Personal name: the footer, About, Contact and every page's structured data no
longer name the person. Each legal text names the operator once
(`{operatorStatus}`, now defining "the operator") and then uses that
reference; the legal notice keeps the person responsible for publication.
Privacy, terms and legal notice become version 1.1. The structured data names
the person as publisher on the legal notice only.

Navigation:
- RouteScroll: a new page starts at its top with focus on its heading; a
  section link lands below the header with focus on it; Back and Forward
  return to where the reader was; no delay, no smooth scroll, real links.
- The phone menu no longer returns focus to its button after navigation.
- The language control: one rule set, three equal 44 px segments with the
  same inset everywhere, no letter-spacing, accessible names "EN, English".
- One related-pages group per page (legal pages, Support, Contact), the
  current page as text; the legal notice's duplicate "Policies" list and the
  in-app article's second list are gone.

Tests: vitest 489, public Playwright 148 (scroll from the bottom, Back and
Forward, sections, focus, menu, selector geometry, one group, 320/375 px,
light/dark), full-surface Playwright 130.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01WqJ1WH6TJWfctbXGjyqFZt
